column1: # Open findings of the fuzz harnesses (dm/tools/fuzz/fuzzlib.py), one row per cause: harness, signature pattern (fnmatch, alternatives separated by |), its inputs in corpus/<harness>/ (comma-separated), issue, what

column5: name() reads the u16 size of a compressed title area from a file shorter than 2 bytes
Image() unpacks the 32-byte header from an image cut short after its magic
mshd_shaders hands a code area shorter than its 0x34-byte header to sph_stage
bnsh_shaders follows the variation table pointer (u64 at +0x80) unchecked; one past the C index range raises OverflowError
yaz0 decodes until the size in its header without checking the input end: a Yaz0 stream cut short raises IndexError
sdf_shaders follows an entry's stage offsets and lengths unchecked: one past the end raises struct.error instead of a red line
sarc_members reads the SARC and SFAT headers and the entry table unchecked: a SARC cut short raises struct.error
glslc_shaders reads control +0x20 and +0x704 of a control section found inside the output without checking that the section is there: an output cut inside it raises struct.error
arh_entries checks that the path prefix from the trie is ASCII but decodes the suffix from the string table unchecked: a non-ASCII byte raises UnicodeDecodeError instead of a red line
tfxo_shaders reads control +0x704 of a control section that ends early: a .tfxo file cut inside a control section raises struct.error instead of a red line

scan_blob reads the size of every 'BNSH\\0\\0\\0\\0' match at +0x1c without checking that the header is there: the magic within 0x20 bytes of the end of any scanned file raises struct.error and the file's other shaders are left out

scan_blob expands SARC members without checking that a member lies inside the archive and is smaller than it: a member that spans the whole SARC is scanned as itself until RecursionError, copying the archive at each of ~1000 levels (a 50 MB archive: ~50 GB)
bahs_shaders reads the code region fields at +0x18 / +0x1c without checking the header is there: a BAHS file shorter than 0x20 bytes raises struct.error
